Subject: Budget range validation & procurement thresholds — PayBridge

Alex — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and the items I promised to follow up on:

1) Your traffic profile: ~250M tokens/month initially, potentially ramping to ~1B tokens/month in 9–12 months as you onboard two new partners. Typical sequence lengths ~80–120 tokens per request, heavy embed usage for search rerank.
2) Pricing sensitivity: procurement wants a target unit price that maps to roughly $8k–$12k/month for the pilot (first 1–2 months) and an eventual target of <$1,000 per 1M tokens at scale, subject to a committed monthly spend.
3) Procurement thresholds: purchase orders required for >$25k, legal review for T&Cs >$100k annually.

Next steps: I can put together a short pricing band that maps your volume profile to three options (hosted API, reserved/dedicated, and hybrid with caching/quantized models). Can you confirm:
- Pilot committed months (1–3)?
- Who is the procurement contact (Lauren?) and their PO timeline?

Attaching the high-level pricing deck and example contract we referenced.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Gomez <agomez@paybridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Park <lauren@paybridge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -04:00

Thanks Dylan — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Pilot: looking to do a 2-month pilot with a ~$10k/mo budget for initial validation (covers dev + limited production traffic).
- Long-term: if performance looks good, expect to budget for ~750M tokens/month within 6–9 months. That map to roughly $750–$900 per 1M tokens target to stay within our operating budgets.
- Procurement: yes, Lauren is the procurement owner — FYI Lauren, typical PO turnaround is 2–3 weeks once pricing & SOW are locked. Anything >$20k needs VP approval; anything >$80k route to formal legal review.

We can share a copy of the internal procurement form if that helps.

—Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | PayBridge

Perfect — thanks for the detail Alex (and hi Lauren). Based on your pilot and scale targets, here's a short mapping so your procurement/finance team can see expected bands: 

- Pilot (250M tokens/month): Hosted API recommended; estimated list cost ~ $9k–$11k/mo before discounts. With a 2-month pilot and standard pilot discount we can land ~ $8.5k/month.
- Scale (750M tokens/month): Dedicated/reserved or hybrid with aggressive KV caching and 8-bit quantized model paths — target unit economics ~ $700–$950 per 1M tokens depending on caching and batching.
- Procurement thresholds: since PO >$20k triggers VP approval, an annualized commitment at your 750M run-rate (~$7.5–$9M/yr at list) would need early legal/finance alignment; we typically structure a 12-month reserved capacity deal with staged ramp to ease approvals.

Neha — looping you in to start drafting a 2-month pilot quote and the standard procurement attachment (we have PayBridge_Procurement_Form.xlsx attached). Aditya — can you confirm whether we can offer a pilot billing cap to keep the first month predictable?

Action items:
- Neha: draft pilot quote + PO-ready summary for Lauren (ETA 48 hours).
- Aditya: confirm pilot billing cap options (consumption cap vs fixed invoice).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Dylan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
